verdict.rationale: Docs and community evidence confirm connect-repo auto-deploy with build detection, PR previews, and rollback, matching the zero-config repo-connect deploy workflow (netlify-docs-1, netlify-docs-25, netlify-docs-5). Community reviews corroborate the GitHub integration and automated builds working well in practice (netlify-comm-7, netlify-comm-10). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic build-command/framework detection logic and independent hands-on confirmation that zero manual config is needed for varied frameworks.
